title: Georgetown Ghost Maker Tour for Adults
includes: Alcohol (Alcohols is not included but you can bring your drinks on the tour)

cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Charming downtown Georgetown may impress you with its beautiful historic buildings, but beneath the surface lies a darker past filled with unsettling secrets. As you explore, you’ll uncover stories of brutal murders, horrific torture, and tragic suicides that have shaped the city’s haunted history.

Join The Ghost Maker Tour and discover a side of Georgetown you never imagined, as you dive into the town’s haunted past and uncover its most unsavory secrets.

Stroll through Georgetown’s shadowy history as your guide shares chilling tales along the way. You’ll hear the story of a Texas family feud that may have led to a murder-suicide at the turn of the century, and question whether the spirits said to linger around the Historic Square are truly at rest. Blending true crime and ghost stories, this experience offers the perfect recipe for a wickedly good time.
